ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Medieval Studies: Gender East and West. The seminar topic is the architectural and arts patronage of women and the gendering of space, both urban and residential, material and performative, from 500-1500 CE. The primary focus will be Islamic society, contrasted with the West for the purposes of comparing methodological approaches and the different kinds of archival and archaeological sources. Guest speakers from on and off campus will contribute to the discussions. Students will write a lengthy seminar paper that both explores a historical problem and discusses its intellectual framework.
